data.narrative:
SwarmFarm Robotics is a Series B-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised AU$30M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), with particular focus on three same-sector, same-stage peers: Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B).

Two valuation methods triangulate a range. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $30M raised proxy, yielding $57M. The peer-median approach uses the three same-stage, same-sector comps, which trade at a median valuation of $1.8B (range: $1.6B–$2.0B). This reflects the scale achieved by leading robotics firms at Series B maturity.

The triangulated valuation range is $48M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $904M across the two methods. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around SwarmFarm's progress relative to more mature peers. Key drivers of placement within this range include capital efficiency since Series A, operational traction in deployment volumes, and technology differentiation relative to the Bedrock/Dexterity cohort. Additional clarity on revenue run-rate and customer concentration would narrow the band considerably.
